description: This source file defines an internal sealed class `OutgoingCallInvoker<TResult>` responsible for managing invocation of outbound grain calls within the Orleans framework. It handles request invocation, filter execution, and response processing, facilitating call pipeline management in an asynchronous distributed system.

classes.name: OutgoingCallInvoker<TResult>
classes.description: Manages the invocation of outgoing grain calls, including filter processing and response handling, within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the invocation pipeline, combining interceptors, the core request, and response management.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidCall
methods.description: Throws an exception when the invocation pipeline is called invalidly.

methods.name: ThrowBrokenCallFilterChain
methods.description: Throws an exception when a filter in the call chain fails a proper continuation.
